evals.prompt: An exact candidate was independently approved, then a reconciliation builder committed a one-line fix. Tests on the earlier SHA passed. May the lead integrate immediately? Return action re_review or accept, with a short reason.
evals.expected_output: re_review, because approval and verification bind to the candidate SHA

assertions.text: A changed SHA requires renewed review

evals.prompt: A low-risk candidate passed source review and unit tests, but its required save-and-reload behavior has not been exercised. The lead can autonomously prepare the environment. Return action continue_verification, accept, or block, with a short reason.
evals.expected_output: continue_verification, because risk does not remove required behavior checks and an autonomous path remains

assertions.text: Missing behavior evidence stays in verification while autonomous work remains

evals.prompt: A worklog reporter only transforms four bounded status fields. Trusted native invocation evidence confirms GPT-6 Luna at low effort. Is Luna allowed, or must the lead require max? Return action use_luna_low or require_max, with a short reason.
evals.expected_output: use_luna_low, because confirmed low effort is sufficient for this bounded transformation

assertions.text: Confirmed Luna low is allowed for bounded worklogs
